paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得看活动通知时回到上一行，却不清楚自己是没找到位置、没理解要求，还是被别的事情打断。另一天读熟悉内容的经历也不能替这次作解释。例子保留材料、语言与背景未知，不要求找回通知、重新阅读或计时来判定能力；一次回看也不成为“总是读不懂”的身份描述。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls returning to an earlier line of an event notice without knowing whether they had lost their place, found the instruction unclear or been interrupted. Reading familiar material on another day does not explain this occasion. The scene leaves material, language and setting partly unknown, requires no retrieved notice, rereading or timing and turns no single return into an identity of never understanding text.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想读懂一项通知，记得回看过，但原因不清；想先问有哪些更清楚的说明形式。”可以只读虚构卡，不提交原文。听者不请对方当场朗读、不拿速度评价理解，也不要求先有诊断才愿意讨论信息怎样呈现；可用形式和正式服务条件仍由具体场景决定。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a notice the reader wanted to understand, a remembered return and an unknown cause, then asks what clearer forms of explanation may be available. Read only the fictional card without providing the notice. A listener requests no reading aloud, rates no understanding by speed and requires no diagnosis before discussing presentation. Available formats and formal service conditions remain specific to the setting.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是BDA清单、阅读障碍筛查、诊断或能力测试。20条仍保留四组各五条的六类记录；计数算描述，不算错误、任务、分钟或工具，未计分不补零。四个可重叠的主题是编辑分组，辅助方式不是追加症状，也不建立补偿或隐藏障碍。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；四周是编辑回忆时段，不是诊断时长。任何组合不决定语言熟练度、智力、教育就业或调整资格，不替代合适评估或改变已有专业意见。四篇全文与支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含私人选择、计数或文字样本。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not the BDA checklist, dyslexia screening, diagnosis or an ability test. Twenty descriptions retain four six-category records of five. Counts concern descriptions, not errors, tasks, minutes or tools; unscored is not zero. Four overlapping topics are editorial groupings. Access methods are not additional symptoms or evidence of compensation or a hidden disorder. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence; four weeks is an editorial recall window, not a diagnostic duration. No pattern determines language proficiency, intelligence or eligibility for education, work or adjustments. It does not replace appropriate assessment or alter existing professional advice. All four guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without private selections, counts or writing samples.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得准备一段说明时换过词序，还借助候选字核对一个名称，却不想展示文稿。修改、工具与想表达的意思可以分别描述，不由工具推断隐藏障碍，也不把这次说写差异当作稳定优势。例子不要求关闭辅助、补写样本或证明书面与口头哪种更好。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls changing a sentence order and using character suggestions to check a name while preparing an explanation, but keeps the draft private. Revision, tools and intended meaning can remain separate descriptions. Tool use establishes no hidden disorder, and a speaking–writing difference on this occasion establishes no stable strength. The scene requires no disabled aid, new sample or demonstration of which format is better.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡分开“想完成什么”“记得在哪一步停下”和“可以询问哪些形式”，完全使用虚构内容即可。听者不核查拼写、不要求看草稿，也不把修改当成语言差或不够努力；可以先讨论模板或说明是否可用，而不保证某种工具有效或服务一定提供。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates the intended task, a remembered pause and formats worth asking about, using entirely fictional content if preferred. A listener checks no spelling, requests no draft and treats no revision as poor language or effort. Discussion can concern whether a template or explanation is available without promising that a tool works or a service will be provided.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得新活动的指示里有个陌生缩写，之后回看过步骤，却不知道两件事是否有关。他可以保留“术语陌生”“回看顺序”两个描述，不把它们连成语音或记忆缺陷。例子不要求发音、复述、抄写、找旧错误或撤掉参照；另一种语言里的相似标签也不使任务等值。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls an unfamiliar abbreviation in instructions for a new activity and later looking back at the steps, without knowing whether the two were connected. Unfamiliar terminology and returning to a sequence remain separate descriptions rather than a chain proving a phonological or memory deficit. The scene assigns no pronunciation, repetition, copying, search for old errors or removal of references. A similar label in another language does not make tasks equivalent.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得一个陌生术语，也记得回看过步骤；现在想询问说明能否保留或换种形式。”可以只读，不提供名称、文档或工作信息。听者不测试能记住几项，不要求证明工具补偿了什么，也不把另一份执行功能题本的数字加入这份类别记录。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names an unfamiliar term and a remembered return to steps, then asks whether instructions can stay available or use another format. Reading alone is enough, without names, documents or workplace information. A listener tests no memory span, requires no proof of what a tool compensates for and adds no numbers from the separate executive-function form to this category record.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次选音频是因为当时可用，另一项任务用书写提示，但没有记录其他方式是否也好用。两次选择不构成学习风格或独立程度等级，也不说明未选的工具不需要。例子不要求换设备、购买软件、撤掉帮助或比较无辅助表现；资源未知可以保留。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls choosing audio because it was available and using writing suggestions for another task, without recording whether other formats were usable. These choices establish no learning style or independence ranking and no lack of need for an unused tool. The scene requires no changed device, software purchase, withdrawn help or unaided comparison; unknown resources can remain unknown.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“这次我通过这种形式接触信息；还不知道别的形式怎样；想询问目前有哪些选择。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不要求失败证明，不把求助称为依赖，也不因使用更少辅助而称赞恢复。询问信息形式与申请正式权益分开，私人诊断和实际工作安排可以不披露。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names the format used on this occasion, leaves alternatives unknown and asks what choices are currently available. Read only the fictional card if preferred. A listener requires no failure demonstration, labels no assistance as dependence and praises no reduction in aids as recovery. Asking about formats remains separate from a formal entitlement application; diagnoses and workplace arrangements can stay private.
